Today's top Hyperoptic discount codes and deals
Looking for a Hyperoptic discount code? We've found the latest verified Hyperoptic promo codes and broadband deals to help you save on your monthly bill. Current offers include up to 25 per cent off selected plans, broadband from £13 a month and up to £300 credit when you switch from another provider.
Our deals team hand-tests Hyperoptic promo codes and offers, checking prices and terms regularly so you can see which deals are actually available.
Top Hyperoptic promo codes and offers
- Up to 25 per cent off selected broadband packages.
- £300 credit when you switch to Hyperoptic.
- Student discount deals starting from £16 per month.
- Fair fibre plans from £13 a month.
Tips on how to save on Hyperoptic broadband
There are several ways to cut the cost of your Hyperoptic broadband, even without a promo code. These include:
- New customer offers: Look for introductory discounts on selected broadband plans.
- Switching offers: Eligible customers can get up to £300 towards the cost of leaving their existing provider.
- Student discounts: Students can access reduced monthly prices on selected plans.
- Fair fibre: Customers receiving certain benefits may qualify for significantly reduced broadband prices.
- Referral rewards: Existing customers can earn rewards when friends sign up through their referral link.
- Price matching: Hyperoptic may match a cheaper like-for-like broadband deal from another provider, subject to its terms.
Hyperoptic 'switch now' offers
If you're dissatisfied with your current contract with another broadband provider, you may be eligible for the 'switch now' promotion. This offers you £300 credit to cover exit fees if you decide to switch to Hyperoptic while mid-contract. Best of all, Hyperoptic will speak to your ex-provider to cancel your current contract and handle any administrative work.
This offer qualifies for 150MB, 500MB or 1GB broadband packages on a 24-month contract. You'll need to contact telesalesteam@hyperoptic.com with your final bill from your old provider to receive your credit.
Hyperoptic student discount
Hyperoptic has partnered with Student Beans to offer students discounts on its broadband and phone plans. If you are a Student Beans member, you can get a 12-month Fastfibre broadband plan from £16 a month or a 12-month broadband and phone plan from £19 a month.
To access this offer, you'll need to log in to your Student Beans account to receive your exclusive code.
Referral incentives
Hyperoptic's existing customers can get up to £75 when they refer a friend. Getting started couldn't be easier:
- Log in or register - If you're already a customer, head to your My Account and click the 'Referrals' tab. If not, just register online to get your unique referral link.
- Share your link - Send it to friends, family, colleagues or anyone eligible. They can use it to sign up for any Hyperoptic residential broadband package.
- Get rewarded - Once their broadband is active for 30 days, you'll both receive a voucher worth up to £75. Rewards are sent within 90 days of activation.
Price match guarantee
Hyperoptic is so confident in its value, that if you find the same package cheaper elsewhere, it'll match it, provided it meets its criteria. It can pay to double check the prices of competitors in your area, to see if you qualify for the Hyperoptic price match. The promise covers broadband or broadband and phone services, with the same service specifications at your residence.
To claim this offer, you'll need to contact Hyperoptic's customer service via phone, email or raise a ticket in your My Account within the first 30 days of service.
The Fair Fibre Plan
Hyperoptic has the fair fibre plan, which offers discounted prices for those who need it most. Those on Universal Credit or other qualifying benefits could be eligible for fast 150Mb for just £13 a month, or superfast 1Gb for £20 a month.
Hyperoptic monthly rolling plans
Hyperoptic recently cut the price of its monthly rolling contracts, challenging the expectation that customers need to commit to longer contracts to access the best prices. Instead, Hyperoptic offers its new and existing customers access to 1Gb full-fibre broadband on a flexible monthly plan from £29 a month.
Hyperoptic prices explained
Hyperoptic broadband prices typically start from around £19 per month for entry-level fibre plans, rising to £36+ for ultrafast 1Gbps speeds. Unlike many providers, Hyperoptic focuses on full-fibre connections, meaning faster and more reliable speeds.
Deals often include:
- Discounted monthly rates
- Free installation
- Short-term promotions, such as gift cards
Is Hyperoptic good value?
Hyperoptic is considered one of the fastest broadband providers in the UK, particularly in urban areas. While Hyperoptic discount codes are limited, its competitive pricing and high-speed fibre connections can offer better long-term value compared with traditional broadband providers.
Hyperoptic vs other broadband providers
Compared with other UK broadband providers, Hyperoptic stands out for its full-fibre network and ultrafast speeds. However, it's only available in selected areas, so it's worth comparing deals with providers such as BT, Virgin Media and Sky to find the best option for your postcode.
Hyperoptic FAQs
Does Hyperoptic offer discount codes?
You can usually find a Hyperoptic promo code offering a gift card incentive for new customers. Most other savings come from discounted monthly pricing, bundle offers and limited-time deals on specific broadband packages.
Where can I apply my Hyperoptic promo code?
Hyperoptic enables you to apply your code before you check out. Look for the 'Do you have a promo code' text under the broadband plans section. You can also add a code later on, under the basket summary.
Is there a Hyperoptic NHS discount?
No, there is nothing directly offered through Hyperoptic. However, Health Service Discounts does run Hyperoptic promotions for NHS or keyworkers.
How we choose the best Hyperoptic broadband deals
With more than a decade of experience in tech and lifestyle journalism, award-winning writer Steve Hogarty knows exactly what to look for when choosing a provider and how to spot the best broadband deals.
With our expert team of deal-hunters, we only highlights offers we'd be happy to use ourselves, so you can be sure you're saving money on an internet service that you can trust.
Why you can trust us
The Independent has been a trusted consumer champion since 1986, reporting on behalf of our readers to find the best deals and discounts on everything from home broadband to travel. Whether it's your next phone contract, regular deals coverage or helping you source the top offers during some of the biggest annual shopping events (think Amazon Prime Day, Black Friday and the Boxing Day sales), our team are always looking out for the best ways to save you money on the products worth buying. We only ever select savings from tech providers that we trust.

There is one catch: Hyperoptic only serves selected properties, so you can't assume it's available in your town or postcode. Check your address first, then compare the speeds, contract terms and total cost against other providers that can connect your home.
